messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Hi, I am interested in purchasing a new SUV. What models do you offer?

messages.speaker: ai
messages.text: Hello! We currently offer the Kia Seltos and Kia Sonet. Are you looking for a compact or mid-size SUV?

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I want to check out the Kia Seltos. Can you tell me the starting price and available variants?

messages.speaker: ai
messages.text: The Kia Seltos starts at around $24,490 and comes in multiple variants. Would you like to schedule a test drive?

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Yes, I would love to book a test drive for this weekend. How do I proceed?
